dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical narrowing of the 2D silhouette from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a subtle convex deviation on the right mid-body; no visible jagged indentations or sharp structural deviations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey to charcoal-grey median intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density of diffuse, lighter-grey circular patches, primarily localized on the right anterior and mid-dorsal sections.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and gradual gradient between the dark grey base pigmentation and the lighter mottling patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, light-toned circular mark is present on the right-hand side of the upper back; blowhole visible as a dark indentation at the anterior tip.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, linear longitudinal ridge is visible along the posterior dorsal axis, creating a clear shadow-casting elevation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single circular pale mark on the right dorsal side, consistent with a healed focal lesion or localized pigmentation variation.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of a sharp, elevated dorsal ridge extending toward the peduncle is the primary structural feature.
